verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS API and SDK product like Stripe Financial Connections, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry controls, usage-tracking opt-out, or SDK or CLI telemetry settings. The pack documents only bank data access, the Link flow, webhooks, testing and the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
